recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future substantive GenomicStudy changes should be handled in the Clinical Genomics incubator IG rather than by editing inactive core resource source, unless the core build later re-adopts the resource.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Clinical Genomics change request, applied for R5, asking to change GenomicStudy.status from CodeableConcept to code to align with MolecularSequence and other status elements.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#2648 applied the change. Commit 25a60c6d128c7c1c60151338d784faaad3c8e3f9 changed source/genomicstudy/structuredefinition-GenomicStudy.xml from CodeableConcept to code, and merge commit dd41deacca4d918d8c768da263eee1dec269b66d also updated GenomicStudy examples and status-codes.xml for primitive status values.
additional_context: GenomicStudy is no longer registered as an active core resource in source/fhir.ini after fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e removed additional resources from the core build. Current core module pages link GenomicStudy to the HL7 Clinical Genomics incubator IG, whose current StructureDefinition also reports GenomicStudy.status as code with a required status value set. Clinical Genomics minutes corroborate the Jira block-vote disposition; no conflicting Zulip discussion was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the requested R5 datatype correction was already made, the remaining core source copy still has code, and the current built core specification no longer owns GenomicStudy as an active resource.
